{{Quote|We can't hold this position, but we'll leave some surprises for Black Sun before we go.|Nidaljo, to a Jedi Knight|<ref name="SWTORRescue" />}}
'''Nidaljo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] who eventually attained the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], he was placed in [[Commander/Legends|command]] of one of the CSF's [[special tactical unit]], which was composed of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Republic soldier]]s. The unit's goal was to fight violent gangs such as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and even the odds for the overwhelmed police forces. On one occasion, Nidaljo and his team&mdash;along with a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;were involved in a [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|raid]] on the [[Black Sun Headquarters]].

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Nidaljo|I'll go with you&mdash;but I won't ask my men to follow.|Corporal|You don't have to. The Jedi's right. We can't let those scum beat us.|Soldier|Count me in. Always wanted to fight alongside a Jedi.|attr=Nidaljo and his men agree to help|src=<ref name="SWTORRescue" />}}
[[File:CSFspecialtacunit.png|thumb|right|250px|Coruscant Security Special Tactical Unit]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> Nidaljo served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He achieved the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. As regular beat cops became overwhelmed by the constant street warfare after the Empire's [[Sacking of Coruscant]], a [[special tactical unit]] was formed with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Republic soldier]]s. Nidaljo was placed in command of the unit, whose specific goal was to actively fight dangerous gangs such as the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate.<ref name="SWTORRescue" />

Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> secret plans for the Republic's [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] were stolen, and its designer, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], was kidnapped. Nidaljo and his men were sent by [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] to the [[Black Sun territory]] to [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|rescue]] the scientist and secure the plans. However, they were overwhelmed by Black Sun's forces while breaching the [[Black Sun Headquarters]], and Nidaljo suffered the [[Death/Legends|loss]] of seven of his men, with four others wounded.<ref name="SWTORRescue" />

{{GameLS}}
A [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] sent by Agent Galen was able to rally Nidaljo, who in turn encouraged the other twenty-two of his men to take the Black Sun stronghold. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], along with Nidaljo and his unit, broke through Black Sun's defenses, they discovered that Doctor Tarnis was in actuality a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who had tricked Black Sun's leader, [[Salarr]], into helping him steal the plans. The Jedi and Nidaljo attempted to arrest Salarr, but he resisted and was killed. Nidaljo knew that the CSF would be unable to retain the territory that they had just fought over and won. However, his fighting spirit renewed, he and his men set several traps to sabotage further efforts made by Black Sun to hold on to the area.<ref name="SWTORRescue" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Look at us. We're half-dead, and they didn't suffer a single casualty. There's no hope of victory.|Nidaljo, after his unit was routed by Black Sun forces|<ref name="SWTORRescue" />}}
Light-skinned with dark [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and dark blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Nidaljo was a loyal cop and a good commanding officer. However, the years of constant street warfare in the aftermath of the Sacking of Coruscant had left him embittered and demoralized. Nevertheless, though faced with seemingly overwhelming odds, through some encouragement Nidaljo was able to rally himself and his men to complete their mission against Black Sun.<ref name="SWTORRescue" />

==Equipment==
As an officer of the Coruscant Security Force, Nidaljo wore the standard gray uniform of the service, and wielded a [[blaster pistol]] in combat.<ref name="SWTORRescue" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nidaljo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]], as part of "The Rescue" Jedi Knight class quest. The player can choose not to rally Nidaljo and his men and subsequently receive [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points.<ref name="SWTORRescue" />
